events.title: Mygohome is Now in Steam Next Fest October! Launching in November
events.summary: Hello everyone! I'm the developer of Mygohome. Steam Next Fest October (Oct 19 - 26) has officially begun! I'm thrilled that Mygohome is part of this event and hope it helps more indie game fans discover the game. 🎮 What kind of game is this? Mygohome is a fully hand-drawn, anime-style survival horror game. You need to monitor anomalies around you, manage your sanity (SAN), and use various unique survival items to deal with danger.
